selection_reasoning: Mining a dead bush causes it to drop sticks as items on the ground. The agent must first break the dead bush block (mine dead_bush), which spawns stick items on the ground, and then walk over to collect the dropped sticks (pick up an item). This forms a natural two-step dependency: you cannot pick up the item until you mine the block that produces it. Both tasks are simple, observable, verifiable, and require no deep Minecraft knowledge beyond basic block-breaking and item collection.

edges.reason: Mining the dead bush drops stick items on the ground, which the agent must then walk over to pick up

milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_most(kind='block', object='dead_bush', max_count=0) because the task is to mine/break the dead bush block. When mined, the block disappears from the world. The box [1,-1,1] to [7,2,7] generously encompasses the dead bush placement at (~4,~0,~4) with ±3 block margin. Checking that zero dead_bush blocks remain in this area confirms it was successfully mined. This is preferred over position-based rules because it directly verifies the block state change.

Uses inventory_has because picking up a dropped item places it in the player's inventory. Dead bushes drop 0-2 sticks when broken without shears. The player starts with an empty inventory (no sticks), so having at least 1 stick in inventory confirms the player picked up a dropped item from the mined dead bush. This is the most direct and reliable way to verify item pickup.

scene_description: A flat sand platform (21x21 blocks) with a single dead bush placed 4 blocks east and 4 blocks south of spawn. The player spawns at the center of the platform with clear line of sight to the dead bush. When mined, the dead bush drops sticks which the player must then pick up.
task_text: Find and mine the dead bush on the sand, then pick up the dropped sticks.
design_notes: Sand platform provides valid substrate for dead bush. Air clearing removes trees/terrain clutter. Dead bush at (~4,~0,~4) is visible from spawn (about 5.6 blocks diagonal distance). Player teleported up 1 block to ensure proper standing position. Sandbox verification confirmed the agent could find, approach, mine the dead bush, and sticks dropped successfully.
